published_delta_A_reproduced_using_ecoli.meaning: Delta_A is the 2D (mu, nu) distance and mu is E. coli's for all three species, so the correlated vectors share an identical coordinate by construction

caveat: the canonical recomputation uses the prior script's own hardcoded tGCN vectors, which are unverified (its E. coli vector sums to 116 genes where K-12 has ~86). indicative only; the shared-mu artifact and the identity counts are exact.
